system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> needs to add <USER> 's version of "What Dreams Are Made Of" on their site!! I'm not down with that shitty Kids Bop version!!"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I totally get it—some songs can be tricky due to licensing agreements. We’d love to have all versions available, but you can check out more info about content here: <URL>. Keep us posted! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is informal and includes '/AI' signature; needs professional tone and removal of signature."}
